# colspan Attribute

#### Course: Learn HTML

## colspan Attribute

The colspan attribute extends a cell across multiple columns. For example,

```html
1<!-- HTML code to create the table -->
2<table>
3
4  <tr>
5    <th>Name</th>
6    <th>Interest</th>
7    <th>Age</th>
8  </tr>
9
10  <tr>
11    <td>Dennis</td>
12    <td>Web Development</td>
13    <td>21</td>
14  </tr>
15
16  <tr>
17    <td>Amy</td>
18    <td>Data Science</td>
19    <td>24</td>
20  </tr>
21  
22  <tr>
23  	<td>Anita</td>
24  	<td>Game Development</td>
25  	<td>30</td>
26  </tr>
27  
28  <tr>
29    <td colspan="2">Average age</td>
30    <td>25</td>
31  </tr>
32</table>
33  
34<!-- CSS to add borders -->
35<style>
36  table, th, td {
37    border: 1px solid black;
38  }
39</style>
```

Browser Output

![A webpage showing a table with colspan.](data:image/png;base64,)

Here, the code <td colspan="2">Average age</td> extends the data cell vertically across two columns.
